# Build release month strings and update the note content.
from datetime import datetime

month_lookup = {}
for song, details in release_info.items():
    dt = datetime.fromisoformat(details['release_date'])
    month_lookup[song] = dt.strftime('%B %Y')

new_lines = []
for line in lines:
    if line.startswith('- ') and 'RELEASED_AT TODO' in line:
        prefix = line.split('RELEASED_AT TODO')[0].strip()
        song = prefix[2:]  # remove leading '- '
        month = month_lookup.get(song, 'TODO')
        line = f"{prefix} RELEASED_AT {month}"
    new_lines.append(line)

new_content = '\n'.join(new_lines)
print(new_content)
